title: Spotify Technology S.A. (NYSE: SPOT) — Institutional Underwriting Dossier
holding_rationale: Spotify (SPOT) is not held across Schwab or Robinhood (0 shares, 0 options). While business quality retains COMPOUNDER_PASS (33.02% gross margin, 33.16% ROIC, €9.89B cash, zero financial debt), Q3 flagged an -11.36% EPS miss, +26% YoY OpEx growth, €538M MLC contingency, and €1,996M purchase obligations. On actual 208.6M Q3 diluted shares and 16.5% ex-SBC FCF margin, Base fair value is $624.00 (0.70:1 R:R at $573.08 vs. $500.25 stop; headline sensitivity $636.63 and Finviz $641.68 also fail 1.50:1) amid US Downtrend (10 dist days), VIX 35.89, and XLC STAGE_4. Assign REJECTED (TIER_0) and retain 100% of cash.

primer: Spotify (NYSE: SPOT) retains COMPOUNDER_PASS fundamentals at 33.02% gross margin, 33.16% ROIC, 788M MAUs, €9.89B cash, and zero financial debt. However, Q3 2026 flagged an -11.36% EPS miss, a +26% YoY OpEx jump, €538M in MLC exposure, €1,996M in purchase obligations, €128M in tax reserves, and 69.3% founder control. Using actual 208.6M diluted shares and a $0.77B contingency haircut, our FY2027E ex-SBC Base Case is $624.00 (+8.1% vs. $577.03), yielding just 0.70:1 support R:R at $573.08 against $500.25. Because both ex-SBC ($624.00) and headline ($636.63) valuations fail the 1.50:1 hurdle amid a 10-distribution-day US Downtrend, VIX 35.89, and XLC Stage 4, we assign REJECTED (TIER_0; NOT_HELD, 100% USD cash).
gate_exceptions: Environment & Browser Probe Note: Executed in a headless Linux cloud worktree where macOS Chrome automation (stage2_scanner.py TheWrap dashboard and live logged-in Robinhood/TradingView tabs) is unavailable. Stage 2 breadth fields (`industry_pct_above_200d_ema`, `sector_rank`) show unavailable and options analysis uses public chain data.

The raw screen reads `BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO` (+2.20% above 10W EMA $564.61). We override to `REJECTED` (`TIER_0`). Ex-SBC Base ($624.00, 0.70:1 R:R) and headline Base ($636.63, 0.87:1 R:R) fail the 1.50:1 hurdle. Macro risk adds a 10-day US `Downtrend`, `VIX 35.89`, `XLC STAGE_4` (`RSI 33.44`), and a close below 20D SMA ($593.61).
